start_demo_ui_server: start the demo UI server as a separate subprocess using python server.py in the scannet offline eval demo directory
stop_demo_ui_server: stop the demo UI server by finding and killing the python server.py process using psutil
run_demo_ui_lifecycle: run the demo UI server start and stop lifecycle for the scannet offline eval demo project
review_demo_ui_functions: review the demo UI start and stop functions that manage the server subprocess lifecycle
refactor_demo_ui_server: refactor the demo UI server start and stop functions to support configurable server paths and process matching
